data.label: SIMULATED / CODE-TESTED / PHYSICALLY UNVALIDATED

watch.label: SIMULATED / CODE-TESTED / PHYSICALLY UNVALIDATED
limitations: EPANET steady snapshots; supply transitions are phenomenological abstractions.
Unaccounted flow is suspicion, not proof of a leak or its location.
Customer outflow is already included in the balance; demand is not subtracted twice.

ear.label: SIMULATED / CODE-TESTED / PHYSICALLY UNVALIDATED
limitations: Paired modeled captures share one sampling clock; no physically validated recorder exists.
Display waveforms are subsampled previews, not a replacement for the full detector recording.
An accepted interval is a qualified candidate, not an exact crack location or calibrated probability.
M05 includes accepted wrong intervals; absence of acoustic evidence does not exclude a leak.

guard.label: SIMULATED / CODE-TESTED / PHYSICALLY UNVALIDATED
limitations: Exactly five wetness channels; UNKNOWN health is not HEALTHY.
Physical collector performance is unverified; dry disconnected electrodes can be indistinguishable from dryness.
Wetness does not establish its source. GUARD-5 can perform worse than reference models.
Modeled residual comparison under M05 assumptions, not an operational repair or independent field verification.
Completing a work order never creates a verification outcome here.
Independent WATCH, GUARD-5 and EAR scenario outputs joined as in M05; not a coupled fluid-acoustic model or synchronized field recording.
